Taproot.description: The Taproot, an ancient, gnarled relic pulsating with a rhythmic energy, infuses the bearer with an unwavering sense of calm and steadiness. Its touch whispers of earthbound secrets and forgotten knowledge.

Fibrous.description: Fibrous, with its tangled web of moisture-loving threads, sops up water like a sponge, enhancing hydration levels as it clings tenaciously to any surface.
